successors.name: German Empire
successors.text: Yap proper; the empire's outer islands (Ulithi, Satawal, Lamotrek, Elato, Ifalik, Ngulu, Fais, Namonuito and some western Chuuk atolls on the Sawei page) have no land cells at the grid and are not…

ledger.x: c. 950: Yap becomes the seat of the Sawei island empire. 'In circa 950 AD, Yap became the seat of the empire' (Gatcheper in Gagil); the page says the empire existed 'since around the 9th century'. The Yap page says the pre-colonial Yapese 'established an island empire and dominion' over the neighbouring islands…
1899: Yap passes from Spain to Germany.

certainty.note: The island is exact; the reach of the tribute network is not a territory and is not drawn beyond Yap.
